Title: Verify GET /users/1 returns 200 with a JSON content-type and a non-empty user object
Precondition: The API endpoint https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1 is reachable from the test environment.
Steps: 1. Send an HTTP GET request to https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1. → Expected: The endpoint accepts the request and returns an HTTP response — status code, headers and body — that the assertions below validate. | 2. Assert that response status is 200. → Expected: The response status code is exactly 200. | 3. Assert that header "content-type" contains "application/json". → Expected: The "content-type" response header is present and contains "application/json". | 4. Assert that JSON "id" is present. → Expected: The JSON field "id" is present in the response body. | 5. Assert that response time is under 5000 ms. → Expected: The endpoint responds in under 5000 ms.
Expected Result: All 4 assertions pass — response status is 200; header "content-type" contains "application/json"; JSON "id" is present; response time is under 5000 ms.
